piece.description: Separately placed Southeast Avenue Ramp Terminal — R40. Includes its entire curved high throat at the highway cutout, including explicit model overhang. Construction and traffic-path ownership remain disjoint.

provenance.geometry: Retained measured highway sockets and separately attached R40 continuations.
provenance.construction: Disjoint sparse ownership; four proper rotations repeated; no reflected traffic.
provenance.partition_review: Corrected straight21-cell highway stamp; all four complete curved high throats belong to separate ramps. Retains puzzle, menu, preview, and reserved block identities. Uninstalled prototype local tile slots follow the reviewed new AutoTileBase grid.
